name: ground-wildlife
notes: Ground war easter-egg wildlife (plan/ground-easter-eggs.md sections 4-5): five flock species that burst from falling trees and fly off into the fog, and leap frames for the ten flyover critters that flee the troops. Every value is an input to tools/ground_wildlife (Go, standard library only). Flock flyers: one selected SDXL + pixel-art-xl + LayerDiffuse transparent keyframe per species (top-down, wings spread) is finished on the CPU into flap A (spread) and flap B (wings raised: span folded toward the body), each rotated to the up-left heading and mirrored for up-right, and quantised to a 4-step ramp from the sector palette pulled toward the species hint (luma <= 0.34, no warm or cyan signal colours). Critter leaps: derived on the CPU from each critter's own walk frame in assets/images/flyover-creatures.png (crouch: squash; leap: stretch), darkened to the 0.34 luma cap, so they stay pixel-identical in design to the critters they extend. Deviation from the render plan (Qwen pose edits for the leaps): the critters are 11-24 px wide and the pose edits proved binary at sprite scale (render plan section 12), so the CPU derivation is the robust choice.
